notes.title: First Dotd Retirement Announcement
notes.notes:
Game announcement [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/684830/view/512965890628649698?l=english]here[/url].

As you may not know, few years back Dotd: Threshold, a rework of Amiss 13 failed yet again, and it had to get retired. I have made an announcement on this on the game community hub, for game related details you can view it there.

In other news CBS series has come to fruition, and CBS: Desolation is in a much better state suited for long gameplay. I do have plans for further work, CBS: The Beginning (title pending) and an undecided possible major release later on.

I plan to keep you updated through out the work, soon you can find me on social media as well.

notes.title: On the Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
As we're approaching closer to release, which I hope will be in early 2025; I would like to thank the several testers who helped through development, and should put it out there that the test keys will have granted the full title as the test has come to an end.
In other news, CBS: the beginning will have new extra content already planned right before the first major patch. This includes game soundtrack and a dlc with level advancement and further story as part of the full game, which can be described as an expansion pack.
Again thank you to those who have helped and endured with especially me through the past several years, in making of the whole series to reach a conclusion.

notes.title: Game Reveal, News!
notes.notes:
Good day, everyone, as we reveal [b]CBS: the Beginning[/b] this week, I have a few words to say on the matter.
 While it's been a difficult process to advance in development and design, this was a very difficult task to put in action on my own. Yet I feel delighted to be in final design and polish steps of my very own video game. You as the audience should at least note the difference as you play through the story itself.

 As the release is close, I also want to start a giveaway soon, for a short test phase before release, possibly on indiedb. We can interact and have feedback if any in a small test group.
